message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Key Points (2024)** | Topic | Summary | |-------|---------| | **Speed Limits** | • General speed limit on interstate highways: 70 mph (except in construction zones).
• Rural interstates: 75 mph.
• Urban interstates: 65 mph.
• State highways: 55 mph (rural) / 45 mph (urban).
• Residential areas: 25 mph unless posted otherwise. | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Children 8–12 must use a booster if they can’t reach the belt. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is illegal.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• For commercial drivers: 0.04%; for drivers under 21: 0.02%.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has the right of way.
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks.
• School buses stopping to pick up/drop off children must have all traffic stopped. | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | • Red light: stop; green: go; yellow: prepare to stop.
• Stop signs: come to a complete stop and yield to traffic on the right. | | **Lane Discipline** | • Keep to the right lane unless passing.
• Use turn signals at least 100 ft before turning. | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk or intersection.
• No parking in front of driveways or on sidewalks. | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Vehicles that are abandoned or unsafe may be towed.
• The towing company must notify the owner and the police. | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Most vehicles must pass an annual safety inspection. | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for bodily injury per accident, $25,000 for property damage. | | **Special Rules** | • **School Bus**: All traffic must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• **High‑way Exit/Entry**: Use the proper lane and signal.
• **Construction Zones**: Follow posted signs and reduced speed limits. | ### How to Find More Detailed Information 1. **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official website provides statutes, regulations, and driver handbooks. 2. **Texas Transportation Code** – Legal text covering all traffic laws. 3. **Texas Driver Handbook** – Practical guide for drivers, including rules, penalties, and safety tips. 4. **Local County Courts** – For specific case law or recent rulings on traffic violations. If you need details on a particular aspect (e.g., DUI penalties, parking regulations, or recent legislative changes), let me know!
